title: Operator route and finite source-only ingress continuation
body:
# Operator route and source-only ingress continuation

Lead decision, TJ may reverse. This consumes the request addressed to studio lead in interaction `09c09bb2-fb42-439f-b234-acabeb3feb2b`. P2P/Mining retains assignment and sole source ownership. The accepted source remains clean, unmerged `e9cb885fbf9513801fca216fe033df7fad38f58a`.

## Parent delivery and pickup

The existing parent CLI returned status ok/completed, gateway run `d496c3c2-108d-4d8c-99ad-14cd3a444ad2`, OpenClaw session `b59ced92-733d-492c-bf7c-4fc7a4e04190`, turn `01a18e56-e532-7cd3-b8c2-6c3c02f12ba4`. Frankie/main explicitly acknowledged pickup on the established main WhatsApp session. This is parent coordination pickup, not privileged-operator acceptance or preparation. The unchanged receipt text has SHA256 `d845a6ee1c896664696d1be5611abae33f6fac6e223d23155664a40756c4d3ef`.

The parent verified the current plan, decision and 8e061330 authority chain. It found no explicit acknowledged privileged-operator grant. Its recommendation is a human administrator on dev-host, using local authentication; actual administrator capability is unverified. The host-exec runbook reserves elevated approval/execution for a human on the host and says terminal sudo requires local authentication. The studio lead independently read that runbook. No agent may perform the human-only approval operation or change permissions to get around it.

## Selected operator/authentication route

Studio lead will ask TJ once to identify and locally authenticate the target-host administrator for this reviewed task-only helper. TJ may designate another authorized administrator. No password or command to run will be sent in chat. This asks only for operator designation/authentication; it does not authorize installation, preparation, native activation or an expansion of sudoers/service permissions. Operator acceptance and actual preparation must later have separate receipts.

The source-reviewed privilege envelope remains only the fixed no-argument `/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/meownero/TJS-2504/helper/profile-root-helper.py`, entry SHA256 `96ecc4c6c32d0c734daeb74930f6994a9325699d390fa7480f209f76487b9c89`, the exact 55 records, and declared installation members. The sudoers text remains a proposal. Root/helper5, child source/data27 and validation53 entries resolve through80 existing candidate/reference bindings and a separate authenticated inputs index. The [source packet](/api/attachments/6672ac6e-c51d-4f86-9fd9-fa64991a5829/content) and [independent source acceptance](/api/attachments/1090038f-ab7a-4a18-8c87-b70b9e454c34/content) remain the reviewable artifacts. Plan section27 and its limits are preserved.

## New finite source-only continuation: installed ingress and durable record authority

This is a new named source authorization, independent of the human authentication answer. Existing P2P/Mining writer `3730ad68-e373-4c8a-84df-2e11327b86a5` may use one implementation pass and one correction pass, at most120 minutes from the first source edit, from clean e9cb885 on the existing isolated branch/workspace, under `vanguard/network/` only. No new writer, worktree, dependency or task is needed.

First inspect and reuse `RootEntry`, `RecordExecutor`, the existing generated-entry/bootstrap transport, `CapabilityStore` and `GrantJournal`. Implement the smallest connected source slice for authenticated installation-index/authority ingress, receiver/custodian identity binding, and durable cross-invocation record ordering/one-use capability state reaching the fixed root entry. Use the existing unnamed seqpacket/SCM_RIGHTS and sealed-context contract. Do not add another transport or replace established semantics. A caller-created sealed FD, matching hash or local JSON is not authority. Explicitly bind the independent trust anchor and distinguish its supplied contract from absent live operator/OS facts.

Observable done: a committed source delta whose real entry/authorization/journal path is exercised with disposable unprivileged files, descriptors, sockets and processes; invalid or substituted authority/index/receiver/custodian must fail before modeled effects; crash, replay, interrupted/ambiguous durability and cross-process reuse must fail closed; recovery must preserve original deadlines and cannot activate or rearm a grant. Demonstrate a known-bad relevant baseline. Bind every affected installed member, inputs index, source/command/proposal digest and acceptance claim. Retain the first failure and owned scratch cleanup. Reuse unchanged receipts with their original authorship.

Freeze and publish one exact readback-verified packet, then request one changed-artifact Platform source consultation on this same deliverable with wake_assignee. Platform must review the concrete trust boundary and identify any remaining actual implementation, not mistake fixture success for installed authority or enforcement. P2P consumes that response and returns the next coherent route decision to studio lead.

Stop at120 minutes/two passes, a concrete incompatibility, an unavailable trust/authority contract that cannot be specified honestly, a consensus/privacy/shared-source boundary, or any need for live privileges. Checkpoint a partial artifact at such a stop. Do not extend the budget or add abstract fallback layers. This authorization does not include the remaining privileged syscall/D-Bus/Docker/storage/PID1/namespace/deadline/observer implementation or live qualification; keep those gaps explicit. Qualification registries stay empty, bootstrap/capabilities stay null, and default invocation must continue to refuse. No source-proposal test can qualify a host adapter.

## Preserved execution boundary

No host/resource/credential probe, original-heavy-lock access, sudo, installation, service/mount/loop/storage/account change, image operation, source/Cargo build staging, compile, container/native process, merge or launch is authorized. No ZFS change, broad sudoers rule or human-only approval by an agent. Actual preparation still needs exact authority and receipts; Platform qualifies concrete live bindings. Formal Core stage `bab7a7aa-fe78-4cc9-8822-2b3d1e9b35de`, decision `47234b59-ff49-4bb7-a20a-19df2c94d52e`, changes-requested count2 and later independent Security stay unchanged. Do not enter Core for a source consultation or an operator wait.

All caps/pins, C1/W11/A<=2/O<=1GiB within15GiB, preparation accounting, runtime2CPU/4GiB/no-swap/256PIDs including overhead,3600+600+300s, original lock66306/657237, separate exact runtime grant, two fresh admissions, persistent C quarantine/tombstone and A custody, full native matrix and accepted-only lead integration remain required. All host/native rows remain NOT_RUN; public launch is disabled.

Studio lead owns delivering and consuming the one operator question. P2P owns the independent source continuation and later reconciliation. Native response delivery/queueing is distinct from writer acknowledgement or source progress.

## Operator question delivery

The single question was sent through the studio-lead WhatsApp route. The connector returned messageId `<message-id>` and delivery runId `789fd3a2-a9bd-4fc2-b592-f0178576f11f`. The question asks only who can authenticate locally as the target-host administrator. No password or command was sent. An answer and privileged-operator pickup are unconfirmed. Studio lead retains the answer and eventual operator handoff; this does not delay the authorized source-only continuation. No human board card was created.

[Unchanged parent receipt](/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#document-operator-route-parent-receipt) preserves the parent's original recommendation and limits. The source-only authorization above is the studio lead's decision; the parent recommendation alone did not authorize it.
